name: dayone-mcp
description: Search your Day One journal: keyword search, On This Day, browse and read entries.
long_description:
Lets Claude search and read your Day One journal on Windows, using the official Day One CLI (@dayone/cli). Read-only: Claude cannot create, change or delete entries.

**Before installing:** install Node.js LTS, then run `npm install -g @dayone/cli`, `dayone setup` and `dayone sync` in PowerShell (or use the one-line installer from the GitHub page, which does all of this).

dayone_cli_path.title: Day One CLI (optional)
dayone_cli_path.description: Leave blank to find it automatically. Only needed if dayone.exe isn't in npm's usual global folder.

tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Keyword search with date, journal, tag, starred and media filters

tools.name: on_this_day
tools.description: Entries from this day in previous years

tools.name: sync_journals
tools.description: Download the latest entries from Day One
